openings.title: Research Assistant: World Models for Robot Policy Learning
openings.coAdvisor: Tarasha Khurana, PhD candidate, Robotics Institute
openings.summary: Work on learned world models for robot policy learning — training models that predict how a scene evolves, and using those predictions to drive action selection. The project sits close to recent work on fast world-action models, and involves both reproducing published baselines and running experiments on new problem formulations.
responsibilities: Read and reproduce results from recent world-model and policy-learning papers.
Implement and benchmark model variants in PyTorch.
Run ablations and keep clean, reproducible experiment logs.
Discuss findings in regular meetings and contribute to write-ups.
requirements: Strong Python and PyTorch; comfortable reading ML papers independently.
Background in deep learning; exposure to computer vision or robotics helps.
Able to work independently and report progress clearly.
Prior experience with video prediction or reinforcement learning is a plus, not a requirement.
openings.applyNote: Email a CV and a short note on relevant work you've done. Mention the posting title in the subject line.
